title: Implement user authentication
description:
Implement authentication for the application using JWT.

The authentication flow should include:

  • User registration
  • User login
  • Access token generation
  • Protected routes

title: Create task dashboard
description:
Build the main task dashboard for managing application tasks.

The dashboard should display:

  1. Total number of tasks
  2. Pending tasks
  3. Tasks currently in progress
  4. Completed tasks

title: Add task comments
description:
Implement a comments section for each task.

Users should be able to:

  • Add a new comment
  • View existing comments
  • Reply to comments
  • Edit their comments

title: Design application layout
description:
Application Layout

Create a responsive layout containing the following sections:

  • Header
  • Sidebar
  • Main content area

The layout should work properly on both desktop and mobile screens.

title: Write unit tests
description:
Add unit tests for the main task management functionality.

Focus on testing:

  1. Task creation
  2. Task editing
  3. Task deletion
  4. Task status updates

title: Improve form validation
description:
Improve validation across the task form.

Required validations include:

  • Title: 3–15 characters
  • Description: Maximum 100 characters
  • Deadline: Cannot be in the past
  • Status: Must be a valid task status
